archiveTitle: Evening Brief | Epic and Newzoo Clash Over Store Prospects

entries.headline: Addendum: Epic and Newzoo Respond in Turn to 'Store Can't Recover' Assessment
entries.summary: Newzoo analyst Emmanuel Rosier told PC Gamer that Epic Games Store is unlikely to reverse its gap with Steam. Epic's VP and GM of the store, Martin Keely, responded that the platform logged 2.78 billion hours of third-party gameplay in 2025, with third-party spending up 57% year-over-year to $400 million. Newzoo later added that Rosier's assessment is not supported by Newzoo data or analysis. The dispute has thus escalated from a single analyst's opinion to public clarifications by both the platform and the research firm.
entries.verification: Opened the specific PC Gamer interview, Epic's official year-in-review, and the 3DM clue page. The interview update directly includes Epic's response and Newzoo's disclaimer; the official year-in-review was checked for third-party hours and spending figures.
entries.timeNote: PC Gamer updated on August 23 to include Epic's response and Newzoo's statement; 3DM published the Chinese clue at 09:43 Beijing time on August 24, within the morning window but missed during that search, so it is included here as an addendum.

entries.headline: Addendum: Twitch and Amazon Face Proposed Class Action Over Default Use of Streamer Content for AI Training
entries.summary: Court records from the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California show that streamer Warren Pandiscia filed a proposed class action against Twitch and Amazon on August 20, alleging the platforms used streamer content to train generative AI without authorization or compensation. This is currently only the plaintiff's claim; the court has not ruled or certified the class.
entries.verification: Opened the specific docket page, verified case number 3:2026cv08721, parties, court, and filing date; two media outlets reported the lawsuit's allegations. Reporting is strictly limited to the plaintiff's claims, not stated as court findings.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 10:19 JST on August 24, which is 09:19 Beijing time; within the morning window but missed during that search, so it is included here as an addendum. The original complaint was filed on August 20.

entries.headline: Addendum: Microsoft Confirms KB5121003 Linked to Game Crashes with RGB Components
entries.summary: A Microsoft support page confirms that after installing KB5121003, devices using certain third-party RGB software or hardware may experience freezes, crashes, access violations, or restarts when running games such as ARC Raiders, MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, and THE FINALS. Microsoft is still investigating; this item does not adopt a registry workaround not yet verified on the current official page.
entries.verification: Opened the specific Microsoft Support update page and verified affected games, RGB component conditions, symptoms, and the 'under investigation' status; media reports were used only for discovery and cross-checking. The temporary workaround mentioned by media was not presented as an official conclusion.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 09:29 JST on August 24, which is 08:29 Beijing time; within the morning window but missed during that search, so it is included here as an addendum.

entries.headline: Addendum: Sony Discloses Over 22.9 Million Cumulative Players for Helldivers 2
entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment announced that as of August 9, Helldivers 2 has surpassed 22.9 million cumulative players across PS5, Xbox Series, and PC. This figure is the number of players who have engaged with the game, not sales; it also serves as the latest official scale metric disclosed when Sony announced the game's addition to the PlayStation Plus catalog.
entries.verification: Opened the specific Sony official announcement page, verified the cutoff date, the 22.9 million+ player figure, and the three-platform scope; cross-checked with independent media and the 3DM clue page. Clearly distinguishes player count from sales.
entries.timeNote: Sony's original announcement was published on August 12; 3DM relayed it within this window at 11:51 Beijing time, and it is included as an addendum due to delayed discovery.

mediaAlts.alt: Official key art of four Helldivers fighting alien creatures around a flag.

entries.headline: Addendum: Publisher Announces Sales Over 150,000 and Players Over 300,000 for Denshattack!
entries.summary: A milestone press release from Fireshine Games states that Denshattack! has sold over 150,000 copies and has over 300,000 players. The game launched in July; these figures were disclosed in an August 21 press release. The two metrics differ; the player count exceeding sales may include subscriptions or other access channels and should not be used interchangeably.
entries.verification: Opened the publisher's product page, a full press release repost, and the 3DM clue page; the release clearly gives 150,000 sales and 300,000 players. No original press release URL was found on the publisher's site, so it is marked as media_relay_official.
entries.timeNote: The publisher's press release is dated August 21; 3DM published the clue within this window at 10:52 Beijing time, and it is included as an addendum due to delayed discovery.
